Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the first repeated word in a given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: First Repeated Word Finder
Main goal: Identify and return the first word that appears more than once in the input string, using a HashSet to track seen words and scanning tokens separated by whitespace; if no repetition exists, return "None".

mbpp_0511.reference_description: Write a java function to find minimum sum of factors of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find minimum sum of factors of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of prime factors (with multiplicity)
Main goal: Factorize the input number and return the sum of its prime factors, counting duplicates (e.g., 12 -> 2+2+3 = 7). It iterates potential factors from 2 upward, divides them out, and adds each factor to the sum; after the loop it adds the remaining num as a factor. Note: there is a bug—the final addition of num occurs regardless, which incorrectly adds 1 when num has been reduced to 1.

mbpp_0509.reference_description: Write a java function to find the average of odd numbers till a given odd number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the average of odd numbers till a given odd number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: AverageOdd.averageOdd - compute the average of odd numbers up to a given odd n
Main goal: For an odd input n, sum the sequence n, n-2, ..., 1 and return their average as an integer (sm / count), which equals (n+1)/2; it throws IllegalArgumentException if n is even and has no handling for negative inputs.

mbpp_0417.reference_description: Write a function to find common first element in given array of tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find common first element in given array of tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: GroupTuples by First Element and Merge Tails
Main goal: Given a List<List<T>> where each inner list starts with a key, group all lists by that key in the order of first appearance, producing a List<List<T>> where each inner list starts with the key (from its first occurrence) and concatenates the remaining elements from all lists sharing that key.

mbpp_0592.reference_description: Write a java function to find sum of product of binomial co-efficients.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find sum of product of binomial co-efficients.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: BinomialCoefficient Calculator. Main goal: compute binomial coefficients using a space-efficient 1D dynamic programming approach (Pascal's triangle) in binomialCoeff(n,k); sumOfProduct(n) returns C(2n, n−1).

mbpp_0664.reference_description: Write a java function to find the average of even numbers till a given even number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the average of even numbers till a given even number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Compute the average of all even integers from n down to 2 when n is even; otherwise return -1. The method iterates by subtracting 2, accumulating the sum and the count, and finally returns the quotient sum divided by count.

mbpp_0621.reference_description: Write a function to increment the numeric values in the given strings by k.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to increment the numeric values in the given strings by k.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: This code defines incrementNumerics, which takes a list of strings and an integer K, and returns a new list where strings that are purely digits are incremented by K; all other strings are unchanged.

mbpp_0619.reference_description: Write a function to move all the numbers in it to the given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to move all the numbers in it to the given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Separates digits from non-digits in the input string and appends all digits to the end, preserving the relative order of both groups; effectively returns a string with all non-digit characters first, followed by all digits.

mbpp_0780.reference_description: Write a function to find the combinations of sums with tuples in the given tuple array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the combinations of sums with tuples in the given tuple array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Pairwise element-wise sums of 2-element arrays
Main goal: For every unordered pair of arrays in testList, compute the element-wise sum (s[0] = a[0] + b[0], s[1] = a[1] + b[1]) and collect these results into a new list, effectively generating all pairwise combinations. Assumes each array has at least two elements; runs in O(n^2) time.

mbpp_0671.reference_description: Write a java function to set the right most unset bit.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to set the right most unset bit.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: BitUtils - Rightmost Set Bit and Rightmost Unset Bit Operations
Main goal: Provide two static utilities: (1) getPosOfRightmostSetBit(n) returns the 1-based position of the least significant 1 bit in n (undefined for n = 0 in practice), and (2) setRightmostUnsetBit(n) returns n with its least-significant 0 bit set to 1 (handling n == 0 and the all-ones case by leaving n unchanged in that scenario).

mbpp_0736.reference_description: Write a function to locate the left insertion point for a specified value in sorted order.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to locate the left insertion point for a specified value in sorted order.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
LeftInsertion: binary search to find the leftmost insertion point for x in a sorted array.
Goal: return the first index i where a[i] >= x (or a.length if x is larger than all elements). Runs in O(log n) time, does not modify the array, and assumes a is sorted in non-decreasing order.

mbpp_0760.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether an array contains only one distinct element or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether an array contains only one distinct element or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Summary_description:
Title: Check if all elements in the array are identical
Goal: The function uniqueElement traverses the input array, inserts each value into a HashSet, and returns "YES" if there is only one distinct value (i.e., all elements are the same); otherwise it returns "NO". Note: the parameter n is unused.

mbpp_0022.reference_description: Write a function to find the first duplicate element in a given array of integers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the first duplicate element in a given array of integers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: First Duplicate Finder
Main goal: Iterate through nums and return the first value that has already appeared; uses a HashSet to track seen numbers. If no duplicates, return -1. Time complexity: O(n), Space complexity: O(n).

mbpp_0888.reference_description: Write a function to substract the elements of the given nested tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to substract the elements of the given nested tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Element-wise subtraction of two 2D arrays
Main goal: Return a new 2D int array containing the differences testTup1[i][j] - testTup2[i][j] for the overlapping rows and columns (min of the input dimensions), effectively computing the element-wise subtraction only over the common region.

mbpp_0097.reference_description: Write a function to find frequency count of array of arrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find frequency count of array of arrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: Count how many times each integer appears across a list of integer sublists and return a map of value to frequency. It iterates every number in every sublist, updating a HashMap with getOrDefault, and returns the resulting frequency map.

mbpp_0083.reference_description: Write a java function to find the character made by adding all the characters of the given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the character made by adding all the characters of the given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Calculates a single letter (a–z) by summing the 1-based positions of all lowercase letters in the input string and mapping the total modulo 26 to a letter; remainder 0 yields 'z'. Time complexity: O(n).

mbpp_0229.reference_description: Write a function to re-arrange the elements of the given array so that all negative elements appear before positive ones.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to re-arrange the elements of the given array so that all negative elements appear before positive ones.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Main goal: Reorder the given array in-place so that all negative numbers appear at the beginning, while preserving their original relative order, using a single pass with a secondary index j to place the next negative.

mbpp_0186.reference_description: Write a function to search some literals strings in a string by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to search some literals strings in a string by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: First-pattern Regex matcher
Main goal: Return "Matched!" if the input text contains a substring that matches the first regex pattern in the provided list; otherwise return "Not Matched!". Note: due to an immediate return inside the loop, only the first pattern is considered and subsequent patterns are ignored.

mbpp_0128.reference_description: Write a function to shortlist words that are longer than n from a given array of words.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to shortlist words that are longer than n from a given array of words.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines a class WordFilter with a static method longWords(int n, String str) that splits the input string by spaces and returns a list of words whose length is greater than n.

mbpp_0178.reference_description: Write a function to search some literals strings in a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to search some literals strings in a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Main goal: determine whether the given text matches any of the provided regular expression patterns and return a simple status string.

What it does: The method stringLiterals takes a list of patterns and a text, then iterates the list and checks if the text contains a match for the current pattern using Pattern.compile(pattern).matcher(text).find(). It returns "Matched!" if the first pattern matches; otherwise it immediately returns "Not Matched!" (due to the early return). If the patterns list is empty, it returns "Not Matched!" by default. In effect, only the first pattern is actually evaluated, which is likely a bug if the intent is to check all patterns.

mbpp_0579.reference_description: Write a function to find the dissimilar elements in the given two tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the dissimilar elements in the given two tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Symmetric Difference of Two Arrays (Dissimilar Elements)
Main goal: Compute the symmetric difference between two input arrays and return a list of elements that appear in exactly one of the arrays (duplicates removed by using sets).

mbpp_0302.reference_description: Write a java function to find the most significant bit number which is also a set bit.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the most significant bit number which is also a set bit.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Main goal: Return the largest power of two that is less than or equal to a non-negative input n (0 if n is 0). It computes the position of the most significant set bit by repeatedly dividing n by 2 and counting, then returns 1 shifted left by that count (1 << floor(log2(n))). Note: negative inputs aren’t properly handled.

mbpp_0264.reference_description: Write a function to calculate a dog's age in dog's years.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to calculate a dog's age in dog's years.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: DogAgeCalculator: Convert a human age to an estimated dog age. The dogAge(hAge) function uses a piecewise formula: if hAge <= 2, dAge = hAge * 10.5; otherwise dAge = 21 + (hAge - 2) * 4. It also exits on negative input and returns the computed dog age.

mbpp_0324.reference_description: Write a function to extract the sum of alternate chains of tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract the sum of alternate chains of tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: AlternateSum - Compute sums of elements at odd and even indices.
Main goal: Given an integer array, compute two sums: sum of elements at odd indices and sum of elements at even indices, and return them as a two-element array [sumOddIndices, sumEvenIndices].

mbpp_0824.reference_description: Write a java function to remove even numbers from a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to remove even numbers from a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Removes all even integers from the provided List<Integer> in place by iterating with an Iterator and calling iterator.remove() when an element is even; returns the same (mutated) list.

mbpp_0852.reference_description: Write a java function to remove negative numbers from array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to remove negative numbers from array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Remove negative numbers from a list. Main goal: Remove all negative integers from the given List<Integer> in place using an iterator, and return the same list without the negatives.

mbpp_0644.reference_description: Write a java function to reverse an array upto a given position.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to reverse an array upto a given position.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Reverse first k elements of a list
Main goal: Return a new list where the first k elements of the input are reversed and the remaining elements stay in their original order; the input list is not modified. Assumes 0 <= k <= input.size(), with no checks for invalid k (may throw for out-of-bounds if k is too large or negative).

mbpp_0752.reference_description: Write a function to find the nth jacobsthal number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the nth jacobsthal number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Jacobsthal Number Calculator
Main goal: Compute the nth Jacobsthal number J(n) using an iterative dynamic programming approach (recurrence J(n) = J(n-1) + 2*J(n-2), with J(0)=0 and J(1)=1), storing intermediate values in a DP array and returning J(n).

mbpp_0868.reference_description: Write a java function to find the length of the last word in a given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the length of the last word in a given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Length of the last word
Main goal: Return the length of the last word in the input string, ignoring trailing spaces.
How it works: Trims the string, then iterates over characters; increments a counter for non-space characters and resets it to zero when a space is found; the final counter value is the length of the last word.

mbpp_0067.reference_description: Write a function to find the number of ways to partition a set of bell numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the number of ways to partition a set of bell numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Bell numbers calculation using Bell triangle
Main goal: Compute the nth Bell number B_n using dynamic programming with a Bell triangle; the function bellNumber(n) builds a triangular array and returns bell[n][0], representing the number of partitions of an n-element set.

mbpp_0063.reference_description: Write a function to find the maximum difference between available pairs in the given tuple array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the maximum difference between available pairs in the given tuple array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Max Absolute Difference Across Pair Lists
Main goal: Given a list of int[] pairs, compute the maximum absolute difference between the two numbers in any pair.
What it does: Iterates through the list, for each pair computes |pair[1] - pair[0]| and keeps the largest value; returns that maximum (0 if the list is empty).

mbpp_0009.reference_description: Write a java function to find the minimum number of rotations required to get the same string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the minimum number of rotations required to get the same string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Minimal rotational symmetry (string's smallest period)
Main goal: Given a string, compute the smallest positive rotation offset i (1 ≤ i ≤ n) such that left-rotating the string by i characters yields the original string; effectively finding the string's minimal period (or returning n if no smaller rotation exists).

mbpp_0078.reference_description: Write a java function to find number of integers with odd number of set bits.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find number of integers with odd number of set bits.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Counts how many integers from 1 to n have an odd number of set bits in their binary representation. If n is odd, the result is (n+1)/2. If n is even, it is n/2 plus 1 when the parity of the popcount(n) is odd; otherwise it is n/2. In short, it returns the count of numbers in [1, n] with an odd bitcount.

mbpp_0120.reference_description: Write a function to find the maximum product from the pairs of tuples within a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the maximum product from the pairs of tuples within a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Maximum absolute product of 2-element arrays in a list
Main goal: Given a list of int[] where each array is treated as a pair, compute and return the largest absolute value of the product pair[0] * pair[1] across all pairs. It iterates, computes Math.abs(pair[0] * pair[1]), and tracks the maximum. Assumes each array has at least two elements; returns Integer.MIN_VALUE for an empty list.

mbpp_0137.reference_description: Write a function to find the ration of zeroes in an array of integers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the ration of zeroes in an array of integers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines a class ZeroCounter with a method zeroCount(int[] nums) that counts how many elements are zero, computes the ratio of zeros to the array length, rounds this ratio to two decimal places, and returns it as a double.

mbpp_0079.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the length of the word is odd or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the length of the word is odd or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines WordLenChecker with a method wordLen that splits the input string by spaces into words and then immediately returns true if the first word has an odd length, otherwise returns false. Because the return happens inside the first iteration, it only ever checks the first word (and thus ignores all subsequent words). If the string is empty or contains edge cases (e.g., multiple spaces), behavior is unreliable. In short, it’s a buggy implementation that only tests the first word’s length.

mbpp_0277.reference_description: Write a function to filter map based on values.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to filter map based on values.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: dictFilter — filter map by minimum value
Goal: Return a new Map<K,V> containing only entries whose values are >= the given threshold n (V must be Comparable). It iterates the input map and copies matching entries into a new HashMap, leaving the original map unchanged.

mbpp_0161.reference_description: Write a function to remove all elements from a given array present in another array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to remove all elements from a given array present in another array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The Utils class provides a generic method removeElements that takes two lists and returns a new list containing all elements from list1 that are not present in list2. It preserves the order and multiplicity of elements from list1 and does not modify the input lists.

mbpp_0308.reference_description: Write a function to find the specified number of largest products from two given arrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the specified number of largest products from two given arrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The method largeProduct computes all pairwise products between elements of two input lists, collects them into a list, sorts the products in descending order, and returns the largest N products (or fewer if there aren’t N products). It uses a nested loop over nums1 and nums2, then sorts with reverse order and takes a subList of size min(N, total products).

mbpp_0310.reference_description: Write a function to convert a given string to a tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert a given string to a tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: StringConverter.stringToTuple
Main goal: Convert a string into an array of non-whitespace characters (Character[]), preserving their order.

mbpp_0321.reference_description: Write a function to find the demlo number for the given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the demlo number for the given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Demlo Number Builder
Main goal: Given a string s, return the Demlo number of order equal to s.length(), by concatenating the sequence 1,2,...,l and then l-1,...,2,1; the function ignores the actual content of s.

mbpp_0371.reference_description: Write a function to find the smallest missing element in a sorted array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the smallest missing element in a sorted array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: SmallestMissing — Binary search for the first mismatch

Summary: Finds the smallest non-negative integer missing from a sorted array of distinct non-negative integers by locating the first index i where A[i] != i using binary search; returns i (or the array length if all 0..n-1 are present).

mbpp_0331.reference_description: Write a java function to count unset bits of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count unset bits of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: BitUtils.countUnsetBits
Main goal: Count how many zero bits appear in the binary representation of a positive integer n, considering only bit positions from the least significant bit up to the most significant 1 (i.e., for x = 1, 2, 4, ... ≤ n). The method iterates over powers of two and increments the count when (n & x) == 0, returning that total. Note: for n <= 0 the method effectively returns 0.

mbpp_0378.reference_description: Write a java function to shift last element to first position in the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to shift last element to first position in the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Utility that returns a new list where the last element of the input list is moved to the front (i.e., a right rotation by 1). The original list is not modified; if the input is null or empty, it is returned as-is.

mbpp_0392.reference_description: Write a function to find the maximum sum possible by using the given equation f(n) = max( (f(n\/2) + f(n\/3) + f(n\/4) + f(n\/5)), n).

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the maximum sum possible by using the given equation f(n) = max( (f(n\/2) + f(n\/3) + f(n\/4) + f(n\/5)), n).
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Bottom-up dynamic programming to maximize sum by breaking numbers
Main goal: For a given n, compute the maximum obtainable sum by either keeping i as is or replacing i with the sum of the optimal values of floor(i/2), floor(i/3), floor(i/4), and floor(i/5), using a bottom-up DP array res[0..n].

mbpp_0412.reference_description: Write a java function to remove odd numbers from a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to remove odd numbers from a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: In-place removal of odd numbers from a list
Main goal: Remove all odd integers from the given List<Integer> by iterating with an Iterator and removing elements during traversal, returning the same list containing only even numbers.

mbpp_0394.reference_description: Write a function to check if given tuple is distinct or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if given tuple is distinct or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: DistinctChecker - Check for duplicates in an array.
Main goal: Determine whether all elements in the given array testArr are distinct by inserting items into a HashSet and returning false on the first duplicate; returns true if no duplicates exist. Notes: Uses equals() for comparison; time complexity O(n), space complexity O(n).

mbpp_0409.reference_description: Write a function to find the minimum product from the pairs of tuples within a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the minimum product from the pairs of tuples within a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Finds the minimum absolute product |a*b| among a list of 2-element int arrays by iterating through each pair and returning the smallest |a*b|.

mbpp_0553.reference_description: Write a function to convert the given tuple to a floating-point number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert the given tuple to a floating-point number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TupleConverter - List to double.

Main goal: Convert a list of items into a single dot-delimited numeric string and parse it as a double using Double.parseDouble. It concatenates each element’s toString() with '.' as a separator and returns the resulting double. Edge cases: an empty list or non-numeric elements will cause a NumberFormatException.

mbpp_0416.reference_description: Write a function to find the maximum sum we can make by dividing number in three parts recursively and summing them up together for the given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the maximum sum we can make by dividing number in three parts recursively and summing them up together for the given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: Compute the maximum value obtainable from n by either keeping n or replacing it with the sum of the optimal values of floor(n/2), floor(n/3), and floor(n/4), using a bottom-up dynamic programming approach with dp[i] = max(dp[i/2] + dp[i/3] + dp[i/4], i).

mbpp_0450.reference_description: Write a function to extract specified size of strings from a give array of string values.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract specified size of strings from a give array of string values.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: StringExtractor: filter strings by exact length
Main goal: From a list of strings, return a new list containing only the strings whose length equals the given length; implemented by iterating over the input and collecting matches into a new ArrayList (no null handling).

mbpp_0483.reference_description: Write a java function to find the first natural number whose factorial is divisible by x.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the first natural number whose factorial is divisible by x.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Smallest factorial divisor
Goal: Determine the smallest i such that x divides i! by iteratively building i! (fact) until fact % x == 0; if no i < x satisfies it, return x.

mbpp_0687.reference_description: Write a function to find the greatest common divisor (gcd) of two integers by using recursion.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the greatest common divisor (gcd) of two integers by using recursion.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Recursive Euclidean GCD

Main goal: Compute the greatest common divisor of two non-negative integers using a recursive Euclidean-style algorithm. It orders the inputs as low = min(a, b) and high = max(a, b); if low is 0 it returns high (gcd(x,0)=x), if low is 1 it returns 1, otherwise it recurses with (low, high % low) until a base case is reached. Note: behavior with negative inputs is not defined and may loop.

mbpp_0554.reference_description: Write a java function to find odd numbers from a mixed array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find odd numbers from a mixed array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Filter Odd Numbers from a List
Goal: Return a new list containing only the odd integers from the input list.

mbpp_0691.reference_description: Write a function to group the 1st elements on the basis of 2nd elements in the given tuple array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to group the 1st elements on the basis of 2nd elements in the given tuple array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Group elements by value after sorting  
Goal: Given a list of key-value pairs (K, V) with V comparable, sort the pairs by V and build a LinkedHashMap<V, List<K>> that maps each value to the list of keys that have that value, preserving the order of values and the insertion order of keys within each group.

mbpp_0629.reference_description: Write a java function to find even numbers from a mixed array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find even numbers from a mixed array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Filter evens from a list
Main goal: Return a new list containing only the even integers from the input list.

mbpp_0932.reference_description: Write a function to remove duplicate words from a given array of strings.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to remove duplicate words from a given array of strings.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: DuplicateRemover - Preserve first-seen order while removing duplicates
Main goal: Implement removeDuplicList that takes a List<String> and returns a new List<String> containing each distinct value from the input, preserving the original order by adding elements only if they have not already appeared.

mbpp_0875.reference_description: Write a function to find the minimum difference in the tuple pairs of given tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the minimum difference in the tuple pairs of given tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: MinDifference - Find the minimum absolute difference across pairs
Main goal: Given a List<int[]> of two-element arrays, compute and return the smallest value of |pair[1] - pair[0]| among all pairs.

mbpp_0726.reference_description: Write a function to multiply the adjacent elements of the given tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to multiply the adjacent elements of the given tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: MultiplyAdjacent — computes pairwise products of adjacent elements. Given int[] testArr, it returns int[] of length n-1 where res[i] = testArr[i] * testArr[i+1]; if the input has fewer than 2 elements, it returns an empty array.

mbpp_0777.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of non-repeated elements in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of non-repeated elements in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of distinct values after sorting
Main goal: Sorts the input array in non-decreasing order and returns the sum of all distinct values by adding the first element and then adding an element when it differs from its previous one (i.e., the sum of unique values). Assumes n > 0; otherwise it would fail due to arr[0].

mbpp_0964.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the length of the word is even or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the length of the word is even or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: WordLengthChecker - First word length parity check
Main goal: Returns true if the first word in the input string has an even number of characters; otherwise returns false. It splits the string on spaces and immediately returns based on the first token, so it does not evaluate subsequent words and does not handle null input.

mbpp_0003.reference_description: Write a java function to identify non-prime numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to identify non-prime numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: PrimeUtils.isNotPrime
Main goal: Determine if a given integer n is not prime (i.e., composite) by checking for any divisors from 2 up to floor(sqrt(n)); returns true if a divisor is found, otherwise false. The method scans the range without early exit and has edge-case caveats for n <= 1 or negative numbers.

mbpp_0040.reference_description: Write a function to find frequency of the elements in a given array of arrays using collections module.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find frequency of the elements in a given array of arrays using collections module.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Frequency Counter for Elements in Nested Lists. Main goal: Compute how many times each element appears across all sublists in a list of lists. The freqElement method iterates all sublists and their elements, updating a HashMap with counts via getOrDefault, and returns the map of element -> frequency. It uses a generic type T and works for any hashable elements.

mbpp_0066.reference_description: Write a java function to count positive numbers in array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count positive numbers in array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Non-Negative Integer Counter
Main goal: Provide a function posCount that counts how many elements in a List<Integer> are non-negative (>= 0) and returns that count.
How it works: Iterates through the list, increments a counter when num >= 0, and returns the final count.

mbpp_0250.reference_description: Write a java function to count the occcurences of an element in a tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the occcurences of an element in a tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TupleUtils.countX — Count occurrences of a value in an array
Goal: Return how many elements in tup are equal to x using null-safe comparison (Objects.equals), counting nulls as equal to null; generic method over T.

mbpp_0105.reference_description: Write a java function to count true booleans in the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count true booleans in the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: BooleanCounter - counts true values in a list
Main goal: Provide a method to count how many elements in a List<Boolean> are true.
What it does: The static method count(List<Boolean> lst) iterates over the list, increments a counter for each true value, and returns the total.
Notes: Assumes non-null booleans; encountering nulls would cause a NullPointerException due to autounboxing.

mbpp_0090.reference_description: Write a java function to find the length of the longest word.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the length of the longest word.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Determine the length of the longest string in a list
Main goal: Return the maximum length among all strings in the given List<String> by scanning once. It initializes max with the first element's length and updates it whenever a longer string is found. Runs in O(n) time and O(1) space; will throw if the list is empty.

mbpp_0199.reference_description: Write a java function to find highest power of 2 less than or equal to given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find highest power of 2 less than or equal to given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Highest power of 2 not exceeding n
Main goal: Return the largest power of two that is less than or equal to n. The method iterates downward from n, checks if a number i is a power of two using (i & (i - 1)) == 0, and returns the first such i. If n <= 0, it returns 0.

mbpp_0326.reference_description: Write a function to get the word with most number of occurrences in the given strings array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to get the word with most number of occurrences in the given strings array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: MostOccurrences; Main goal: Given a list of strings, find and return the most frequently occurring word across all strings. The code builds a frequency map by splitting each string on whitespace (\\s+) into words, increments counts in a HashMap, and then returns the word with the highest count using Collections.max with a value-based comparator. Edge cases: may throw if input is empty or contains no words; ties are resolved arbitrarily by max.

mbpp_0329.reference_description: Write a java function to count negative numbers in array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count negative numbers in array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: NegCounter: Counts non-positive integers in a list. It tallies how many elements are <= 0 in a given List<Integer> by iterating through the list and returning the count.

mbpp_0318.reference_description: Write a java function to find the maximum volume of a cuboid with given sum of sides.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the maximum volume of a cuboid with given sum of sides.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Maximize the volume of a cuboid with integer side lengths whose sum is s

Main goal: For a given s, compute the maximum product i * j * k with i, j, k as nonnegative integers summing to s (i + j + k = s) by brute-forcing i and j and deriving k = s - i - j.

mbpp_0303.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the count of inversion of two types are same or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the count of inversion of two types are same or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Validate sequence by comparing each element to the max of earlier elements (excluding the immediate predecessor)
Goal: Return true if every element a[i] (for i >= 2) is at least the maximum of all previous elements a[0..i-2]; if any a[i] is smaller, return false. The function uses a running maximum (mx) updated with a[i-1] after each check, yielding O(n) time and O(1) space.

mbpp_0402.reference_description: Write a function to compute the value of ncr%p.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to compute the value of ncr%p.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Modulo binomial coefficient calculator
Main goal: Compute nCr modulo p in O(n*r) time and O(r) space by iteratively building Pascal's triangle rows with a 1D DP array.

mbpp_0388.reference_description: Write a java function to find the highest power of 2 that is less than or equal to n.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the highest power of 2 that is less than or equal to n.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Highest power of 2 not exceeding n
Goal: Return the largest power of two less than or equal to n by descending from n and returning the first i that is a power of two (detected with (i & (i - 1)) == 0).

mbpp_0400.reference_description: Write a function to extract the frequency of unique tuples in the given array order irrespective.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract the frequency of unique tuples in the given array order irrespective.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Distinct Sorted Sublists Counter
Main goal: Count how many unique inner lists exist when treating each inner list as a multiset (order-insensitive). The method sorts a copy of every sublist, inserts them into a set, and returns the size of that set; duplicates across sublists are collapsed.

mbpp_0401.reference_description: Write a function to perform index wise addition of tuple elements in the given two nested tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to perform index wise addition of tuple elements in the given two nested tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: produce a new 2D int array where each element is the sum of corresponding elements from two input 2D arrays (same dimensions). The method allocates a result with the same outer length as testTup1, iterates over rows and columns, and assigns res[i][j] = testTup1[i][j] + testTup2[i][j]. It assumes both inputs have identical shapes (and are non-null) and does not handle mismatched sizes or nulls.

mbpp_0583.reference_description: Write a function for nth catalan number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function for nth catalan number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Computes the nth Catalan number (C_n) using naive recursion: C_n = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} C_i * C_{n-1-i}, with base cases C_0 = C_1 = 1; returns the result as a long.

mbpp_0614.reference_description: Write a function to find the cumulative sum of all the values that are present in the given tuple array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the cumulative sum of all the values that are present in the given tuple array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: CumulativeSumCalculator
Main goal: Compute the total sum of all integers contained in a list of integer lists by iterating each inner list and adding all its elements to a running total, then returning the final sum.

mbpp_0507.reference_description: Write a function to remove specific words from a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to remove specific words from a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Removes from the given list (list1) all elements that appear in the second list (removeWords). It iterates over a snapshot of list1 and, for each word found in removeWords, removes that word from list1, then returns the mutated list1. It mutates the input list and uses contains() for membership checks (could be optimized by using a Set for faster lookups).

mbpp_0692.reference_description: Write a java function to find the last two digits in factorial of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the last two digits in factorial of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: LastTwoDigitsOfFactorial; Main goal: For a given N, compute the last two digits of N! by iteratively multiplying 1..N and taking modulo 100, returning the result as an Integer; if N >= 10, the method returns null (handles only N < 10).

mbpp_0694.reference_description: Write a function to extract unique values from the given map values.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract unique values from the given map values.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Get all unique elements from map values and return a sorted list.
Main goal: Collect, deduplicate, and sort all T elements found in any List<T> value of the input map, returning as List<T>. The method is generic on T extends Comparable and uses a HashSet to deduplicate before sorting.

mbpp_0880.reference_description: Write a java function to find number of solutions in quadratic equation.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find number of solutions in quadratic equation.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: QuadraticSolver
Main goal: Determine the number of real roots of a quadratic equation by computing the discriminant (b^2 - 4ac) and returning "2 solutions", "1 solution", or "No solutions" (note: it does not handle the degenerate case a == 0 or floating-point tolerance).

mbpp_0878.reference_description: Write a function to check if the given tuple contains only k elements.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if the given tuple contains only k elements.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TupleChecker.checkTuples
Goal: Determine whether all elements in testTuple (a List<T>) are contained in K (a Collection<T>), i.e., whether testTuple is a subset of K. Returns true if every element is present; false otherwise. Implemented as a static generic method using a for-each loop and K.contains(ele).

mbpp_0845.reference_description: Write a java function to count the number of digits in factorial of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the number of digits in factorial of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code provides a method to compute the number of decimal digits in n! (the factorial of n). It uses Kamenetsky's formula to estimate the digit count for n > 1, with edge-case handling: returns 0 for negative inputs, and 1 for n <= 1.

mbpp_0091.reference_description: Write a function to check if a substring is present in a given array of string values.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if a substring is present in a given array of string values.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: SubstringFinder: check if any list element contains a substring
Main goal: Determine if any string in a List<String> contains the given substring and return true if found; otherwise return false.

mbpp_0947.reference_description: Write a java function to find the length of the shortest word.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the length of the shortest word.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: ShortestWordLength class: Main goal — compute and return the smallest length among the strings in the input List by iterating and comparing their lengths.

mbpp_0109.reference_description: Write a java function to find the count of rotations of a binary string with odd value.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the count of rotations of a binary string with odd value.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Returns the count of '1' characters in the first n characters of string s (i.e., in s[0..n-1]); it iterates through the prefix and increments a counter each time it encounters '1'.

mbpp_0100.reference_description: Write a function to find the next smallest palindrome of a specified number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the next smallest palindrome of a specified number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Find the next palindrome
Goal: Given a long number, repeatedly increment from num+1 and check if its decimal representation is a palindrome; return the first such number, or -1 if none is found.

mbpp_0202.reference_description: Write a function to remove even characters in a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to remove even characters in a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: Return a string consisting of the characters at odd positions (1st, 3rd, 5th, ...) of the input string, effectively removing characters at even positions. It builds the result with a StringBuilder by iterating i from 1 to length and appending when i is odd. Note: the method name is a bit misleading, since it removes even-positioned characters rather than numeric even digits; the class lacks a main method.

mbpp_0221.reference_description: Write a java function to find the first even number in a given array of numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the first even number in a given array of numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: FirstEvenFinder; Goal: Return the first even number from a list of integers, or -1 if none exist.

mbpp_0168.reference_description: Write a java function to find the frequency of a number in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the frequency of a number in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: FrequencyFinder — Counts how many times the value x occurs in the given int array a (computes the frequency of x in a).

mbpp_0204.reference_description: Write a java function to count the occurrence of a given character in a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the occurrence of a given character in a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Counter.count – Counts occurrences of a character in a string
Main goal: Provide a static method count(String s, char c) that scans the input string and returns how many times the character c appears by iterating through the string and incrementing a counter on each match.

mbpp_0288.reference_description: Write a function to count array elements having modular inverse under given prime number p equal to itself.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to count array elements having modular inverse under given prime number p equal to itself.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines modularInverse(int[] arr, int N, int P) which counts how many elements x in arr satisfy x^2 ≡ 1 (mod P). In other words, it counts numbers that are their own multiplicative inverse modulo P. The function is misnamed (it does not compute an inverse) and may suffer from int overflow if elements are large.

mbpp_0226.reference_description: Write a java function to remove the characters which have odd index values of a given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to remove the characters which have odd index values of a given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Extract characters at even positions from a string
Goal: Implement oddValuesString(String str) to return a new string composed of characters from the input string at even indices (0, 2, 4, ...). It iterates over the input, appends characters at even positions to a StringBuilder, and returns the resulting string. Note: the method name is misleading; it actually collects characters from even indices.

mbpp_0295.reference_description: Write a function to return the sum of all divisors of a number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to return the sum of all divisors of a number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of proper divisors
Main goal: Compute the sum of all positive divisors of a given integer excluding the number itself. It initializes sum to 1 (accounting for divisor 1) and iterates i from 2 to number-1, adding i when number is divisible by i, then returns the total. Note: for numbers <= 1 the result may not reflect the conventional sum of proper divisors.

mbpp_0270.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of even numbers at even positions.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of even numbers at even positions.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of even-valued elements at even indices among the first n elements
Main goal: Traverse even indices (0, 2, 4, ...) up to n-1 and accumulate those elements that are themselves even; return the total sum.

mbpp_0389.reference_description: Write a function to find the n'th lucas number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the n'th lucas number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Recursive Lucas number calculator
Main goal: Return the nth Lucas number using a direct recursive definition: L0 = 2, L1 = 1, and Ln = L(n-1) + L(n-2) for n >= 2. The implementation uses plain recursion with no memoization, resulting in exponential time and possible overflow for large n.

mbpp_0380.reference_description: Write a function to generate a two-dimensional array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to generate a two-dimensional array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: MultiListGenerator — generates a 2D multiplication-index matrix
Main goal: Create a two-dimensional int array of size rowNum x colNum where each element at (row, col) equals row * col, effectively producing a multiplication-table-like matrix based on array indices.

mbpp_0313.reference_description: Write a java function to print positive numbers in array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to print positive numbers in array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: Given a List<Integer>, return the first element that is >= 0; if no non-negative numbers exist, return null.

mbpp_0377.reference_description: Write a java function to remove all occurrences of a character in a given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to remove all occurrences of a character in a given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Remove a Specific Character from a String
Main goal: Provide a utility to remove all occurrences of a given character from a string.
Summary: The removeChar(s, c) method iterates through the input string, appends every character that is not equal to c to a StringBuilder, and returns the resulting string.

mbpp_0517.reference_description: Write a java function to find the largest postive number from the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the largest postive number from the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
LargestPos — Finds the maximum value in an int array
Main goal: Return the largest element in list1 by a single pass. It initializes max to the first element, scans all elements updating max when a larger value is found, and returns max. Time complexity: O(n); space complexity: O(1). Note: will throw an error if the input array is empty.

mbpp_0436.reference_description: Write a java function to print negative numbers in array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to print negative numbers in array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: NegNos - Find the first negative number in a list
Main goal: Given a List<Integer>, iterate through it and return the first negative value found; if no negatives exist, return null.

mbpp_0443.reference_description: Write a java function to find the largest negative number from the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the largest negative number from the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Find the minimum element in an int array (despite the method name)
Main goal: The code implements largestNeg to return the smallest value in the input array by keeping track of the current minimum and updating it when a smaller value is found. It actually computes the minimum, not the maximum, and assumes a non-empty array.

mbpp_0437.reference_description: Write a function to remove odd characters in a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to remove odd characters in a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Removes characters at odd positions by iterating i from 1 to length and appending only when i is even (i-1 index). The result is the 2nd, 4th, 6th, ... characters of the input.

mbpp_0610.reference_description: Write a java function to remove the k'th element from a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to remove the k'th element from a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: ListUtils.removeKthElement - remove the k-th element from a list
Main goal: Return a new list that is a copy of the input with the k-th element removed (1-based indexing); if k is out of range, the copy is returned unchanged.

mbpp_0666.reference_description: Write a function to count occurrence of a character in a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to count occurrence of a character in a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Counts the number of occurrences of a specified character in a string by iterating through the string and returning the final count.

mbpp_0567.reference_description: Write a function to check whether a specified array is sorted or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check whether a specified array is sorted or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: isSortedList utility
Main goal: Check if a List of elements that implement Comparable is sorted in non-decreasing (ascending) order.
How: Iterates adjacent pairs and returns false if any pair is out of order; otherwise returns true. Empty or single-element lists are considered sorted.

mbpp_0633.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of xor of all pairs of numbers in the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of xor of all pairs of numbers in the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Compute total XOR of all pairs
Main goal: Given an array, compute the sum of arr[i] XOR arr[j] for every unordered pair (i < j) by iterating all pairs and accumulating their XOR.

mbpp_0667.reference_description: Write a java function to count number of vowels in the string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count number of vowels in the string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: VowelCounter
Main goal: Count how many characters in an input string are found in a given set of characters (the vowels string). The CheckVow method iterates over each character of the input and increments a counter whenever the character exists in the vowels string (using indexOf), then returns the total count. Note: this is case-sensitive and does not null-check inputs.

mbpp_0741.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether all the characters are same or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether all the characters are same or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: AllCharactersSame. Main goal: Determine if all characters in a string are identical by comparing each character to the first character; returns true if all match (empty string considered true), otherwise false.

mbpp_0807.reference_description: Write a java function to find the first odd number in a given array of numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the first odd number in a given array of numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: FirstOddFinder - Find the first odd number in a list
Main goal: Provide a method firstOdd that iterates through a List<Integer> and returns the first odd value encountered (num % 2 != 0); if no odd numbers are found, it returns -1.

mbpp_0695.reference_description: Write a function to check if each element of the second tuple is greater than its corresponding index in the first tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if each element of the second tuple is greater than its corresponding index in the first tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Componentwise Strict Less-Than Checker
Main goal: Returns true if every overlapping pair of elements satisfies testArr1[i] < testArr2[i] for i from 0 to min(len1, len2)−1; otherwise returns false. Extra elements beyond the shorter length are ignored. If either array is empty, it returns true (vacuous). Time complexity: O(min(n, m)).

mbpp_0809.reference_description: Write a function to check if each element of second tuple is smaller than its corresponding index in first tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if each element of second tuple is smaller than its corresponding index in first tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Elementwise greater-than check between two integer arrays
Main goal: Check if every corresponding element of testTup1 is strictly greater than the corresponding element of testTup2 up to the length of the shorter array; return true if this holds for all pairs, otherwise return false. Extra elements beyond the shorter length are ignored.

mbpp_0897.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the word is present in a given sentence or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the word is present in a given sentence or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: WordChecker - Word presence checker
Main goal: Implement isWordPresent(sentence, word) to check if the sentence contains the given word as an exact token by splitting on spaces and comparing tokens; returns true if found, else false. Note: uses a simple space delimiter and exact match; does not handle punctuation or irregular whitespace.

mbpp_0942.reference_description: Write a function to check if any array element is present in the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if any array element is present in the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: Determine if testList shares at least one element with checkList. The method iterates through checkList and returns true on the first element found in testList; if no common element exists, it returns false. It is generic over type T.

mbpp_0909.reference_description: Write a function to find the previous palindrome of a specified number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the previous palindrome of a specified number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines a class PreviousPalindrome with a method previousPalindrome(int num) that finds the largest palindrome number strictly less than the given positive integer num. It does this by decrementing from num-1 down to 1 and checking each candidate by converting it to a string and comparing it to its reverse; if a palindrome is found, it returns that number; if none exists, it returns 0.

mbpp_0260.reference_description: Write a function to find the nth newman–shanks–williams prime number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the nth newman–shanks–williams prime number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Newman–Shanks–Williams sequence term calculator
Main goal: Compute the n-th term S_n of the Newman–Shanks–Williams recurrence (S_0 = S_1 = 1; S_n = 2*S_{n-1} + S_{n-2}) and return it as a BigInteger. Note: NSW primes would be p_n = S_n^2 - 2, but this code only computes S_n.

mbpp_0955.reference_description: Write a function to find out, if the given number is abundant.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find out, if the given number is abundant.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: AbundantChecker. Main goal: Provide a method isAbundant(int n) that sums all proper divisors of n (numbers less than n that evenly divide n) and returns true if this sum exceeds n, indicating n is an abundant number; otherwise returns false.

mbpp_0675.reference_description: Write a function to add two integers. however, if the sum is between the given range it will return 20.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to add two integers. however, if the sum is between the given range it will return 20.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Code Overview: Defines SumNums with sumNums(x, y, m, n) that computes sum = x + y; if sum is within the half-open range [m, n) it returns 20, otherwise it returns the actual sum. The goal is to override the computed sum with a fixed value (20) when the sum falls inside that specified range.

mbpp_0960.reference_description: Write a function to solve tiling problem.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to solve tiling problem.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Computes the nth Fibonacci number using naive recursion (base cases F(0)=0, F(1)=1); the class name suggests a tiling context, but the code implements Fibonacci directly.

mbpp_0713.reference_description: Write a function to check if the given tuple contains all valid values or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if the given tuple contains all valid values or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: All-true check for a boolean array
Main goal: Determine whether every element in the input boolean array is true; it returns true if all elements are true (an empty array also results in true), otherwise it returns false as soon as a false element is found.

mbpp_0796.reference_description: Write function to find the sum of all items in the given map.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write function to find the sum of all items in the given map.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of Map Integer Values
Main goal: Compute and return the sum of all Integer values stored in the given Map by iterating over its values and accumulating them.
Notes: Assumes the map and all values are non-null; a null map or any null value would cause exceptions.

mbpp_0775.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether every odd index contains odd numbers of a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether every odd index contains odd numbers of a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Odd-Even Index Parity Checker
Goal: Determine whether every element in the integer array nums has the same parity as its index (i.e., nums[i] % 2 == i % 2). It iterates through all elements and returns false on the first mismatch, otherwise true after checking all elements.

mbpp_0790.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether every even index contains even numbers of a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether every even index contains even numbers of a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Checks whether every element in the input array has the same parity as its index (even index → even number, odd index → odd number). Returns true if all positions match; false otherwise. Runs in O(n) time and O(1) extra space.

mbpp_0808.reference_description: Write a function to check if the given tuples contain the k or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if the given tuples contain the k or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Generic array containment check
Main goal: Implement a generic method checkK that searches a T[] array (testTup) for a given element K and returns true if an element equal to K exists (using equals), otherwise returns false.
Notes: May throw NullPointerException if the array contains null elements since ele.equals(K) is called without a null check.

mbpp_0804.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the product of numbers is even or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the product of numbers is even or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: isProductEven
Goal: Return true if any of the first n elements of arr is even (i.e., the product of those elements would be even); otherwise return false. It detects evenness using a bitwise parity check (arr[i] & 1) == 0.

mbpp_0802.reference_description: Write a java function to count the number of rotations required to generate a sorted array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the number of rotations required to generate a sorted array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: RotationCounter - Find rotation pivot in a rotated sorted array.

Main goal: Identify how many times a sorted ascending array has been rotated by scanning for the first inversion (arr[i] < arr[i-1]). The function countRotation returns that index i, or returns 0 if no rotation is detected. It runs in O(n) time with a single linear pass and assumes n is the array length; it does not handle nulls or empty arrays explicitly.

mbpp_0833.reference_description: Write a function to get map keys as array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to get map keys as array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Returns a List of all keys from the given map by iterating its keySet and collecting keys into a new ArrayList.

mbpp_0890.reference_description: Write a java function to find the index of an extra element present in one sorted array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the index of an extra element present in one sorted array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: ExtraElementFinder - first differing index finder
Goal: Given two int arrays arr1 and arr2 and a length n, return the smallest index i (0 ≤ i < n) where arr1[i] differs from arr2[i]; if all first n elements are equal, return n.

mbpp_0889.reference_description: Write a function to reverse each array in a given array of arrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to reverse each array in a given array of arrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Reverse-sorted inner lists in-place
Main goal: This generic Java method takes a List<List<T>> (where T extends Comparable) and sorts each inner list in reverse (descending) order using Collections.sort with Collections.reverseOrder(), mutating the inner lists in place. It returns the same outer list reference.

mbpp_0908.reference_description: Write a function to find the fixed point in the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the fixed point in the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Fixed Point Finder
Main goal: Find an index i within the first n elements where arr[i] == i, returning that index or -1 if none exists.

mbpp_0084.reference_description: Write a function to find the n-th number in newman conway sequence.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the n-th number in newman conway sequence.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Java implementation of the Newman-Conway sequence
Main goal: Provide a recursive function sequence(n) that returns the Newman-Conway sequence value, with base cases sequence(1) = 1 and sequence(2) = 1, and for n > 2 computes sequence(n) = sequence(sequence(n-1)) + sequence(n - sequence(n-1)).

mbpp_0873.reference_description: Write a function to solve the fibonacci sequence using recursion.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to solve the fibonacci sequence using recursion.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Recursive Fibonacci Calculator
Main goal: Return the nth Fibonacci number using naive recursion, with base cases f(1) = f(2) = 1 and f(n) = f(n-1) + f(n-2).

mbpp_0081.reference_description: Write a function to zip the two given tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to zip the two given tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: It zips two lists into a list of Pair objects by pairing each element from the first list with the corresponding element from the second list, cycling through the second list if needed (i % n2). It defines a generic Pair<T, U> to hold the paired values. Note: if the second list is empty, the modulo operation will throw an exception; potential null inputs could also cause NPEs.

mbpp_0198.reference_description: Write a function to find the largest triangle that can be inscribed in an ellipse.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the largest triangle that can be inscribed in an ellipse.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: EllipseUtils.largestTriangle
Main goal: Given ellipse parameters a and b, compute (3√3 * a^2) / (4b) when both are non-negative; return -1 if either is negative. The code appears intended to compute a triangle-related metric tied to ellipse parameters, though the standard maximum-area triangle in an ellipse is (3√3/4)ab.

mbpp_0934.reference_description: Write a function to find the nth delannoy number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the nth delannoy number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Computes the Delannoy number D(n, m) recursively: D(n,m) = D(n-1,m) + D(n-1,m-1) + D(n,m-1) with base cases D(0,m) = D(n,0) = 1. The code implements this via swapped arguments in the first two terms (still yielding the same result due to symmetry) and uses an exponential recursion without memoization; note the method name is misspelled.

mbpp_0061.reference_description: Write a java function to count number of substrings with the sum of digits equal to their length.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count number of substrings with the sum of digits equal to their length.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Substring Count with Average Digit 1

Main goal: Given a digit string s and an integer n, count how many substrings within the first n characters have the sum of digits equal to the substring length (i.e., average digit equals 1).

How it works (brief): It computes a running prefix sum of digits and uses a HashMap to store frequencies of the value (prefixSum - (index+1)). For each position i, the number of valid substrings ending at i equals the number of previous positions with the same key. It starts with key 0 mapped to 1 to account for substrings starting at the beginning. Time complexity is O(n) and space complexity is O(n). Returns the total count as a long.

mbpp_0951.reference_description: Write a function to find the maximum of similar indices in two arrays of tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the maximum of similar indices in two arrays of tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Java code defines a generic Pair<F,S>, then a method maxSimilarIndices that takes two lists of Pair<Integer,Integer>, and for each index up to the shorter list length, creates a new Pair whose first is the max of the two first components and whose second is the max of the two second components. Returns the list of these max-pairs.

mbpp_0391.reference_description: Write a function to convert more than one array to nested map.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert more than one array to nested map.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Converter — Build a List of Nested Maps from Three Parallel Lists

Main goal: Given three lists l1 (type K), l2 (type V), and l3 (type W), produce a List<Map<K, Map<V, W>>>. For each index i up to the minimum of the three sizes, create an inner map with l2[i] -> l3[i], then an outer map with l1[i] -> (inner map), and add this outer map to the result. The process is bounded by the smallest list length; the method returns the list of these single-entry maps.

mbpp_0766.reference_description: Write a function to iterate over all pairs of consecutive items in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to iterate over all pairs of consecutive items in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: PairWise - Generate adjacent element pairs
Main goal: Given a list, produce a list of pairs where each pair contains two consecutive elements (i and i+1). It defines a generic Pair<T,U> class and a generic pairWise<T> method that returns a List<Pair<T,T>> by iterating up to size-1 and pairing neighboring elements. Empty or single-element lists yield an empty result.

mbpp_0545.reference_description: Write a java function to toggle only first and last bits of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to toggle only first and last bits of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Toggle the most significant and related bit(s) of an integer
Main goal: For an input int n, compute a mask based on the highest set bit (essentially (1<<msb(n)) + 1, with a special case when msb(n)=0) using a cascade of shifts, and return n XOR that mask to flip those bits. The helper takeLAndFSetBits builds this mask by propagating the MSB through lower bits.

mbpp_0669.reference_description: Write a function to check whether the given ip address is valid or not using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check whether the given ip address is valid or not using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Validates whether a given string is a valid IPv4 address using a regex pattern; checkIP returns "Valid IP address" if matched, otherwise "Invalid IP address".

mbpp_0735.reference_description: Write a java function to toggle bits of the number except the first and the last bit.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to toggle bits of the number except the first and the last bit.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Given an integer n, the code flips (toggles) all bits strictly between the least significant 1 and the most significant 1 in n, leaving the end bits unchanged. The helper setMiddleBits builds a mask with 1s in the interior bit positions (between bit 1 and the MSB-1) and 0s at the ends, and toggleMiddleBits returns n XOR that mask. Edge cases: n = 1 is handled specially; for 2 or 3 there are no interior bits to toggle, so the value is unchanged.

mbpp_0194.reference_description: Write a java function to convert octal number to decimal number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to convert octal number to decimal number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Octal to Decimal Converter
Main goal: Convert a number written in octal (as a decimal integer whose digits are octal digits) to its decimal value.
How: Extracts each octal digit from least significant to most significant (digit = temp % 10), accumulates decValue += digit * base, and updates base by multiplying by 8; returns the decimal result. Assumes input digits are 0–7; no input validation.

mbpp_0857.reference_description: Write a function to array out the array of given strings individually using map function.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to array out the array of given strings individually using map function.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: listifyList - Converts a List<String> to a List<List<Character>>. Main goal: Map each string to a list of its characters in order and collect the results into a list of character lists.

mbpp_0007.reference_description: Write a function to find all words which are at least 4 characters long in a string by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find all words which are at least 4 characters long in a string by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: RegexUtils.findCharLong — extract long words from text
Main goal: Return all words with length >= 4 from the input string as a List<String>, using the regex \b\w{4,}\b.

mbpp_0905.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of squares of binomial co-efficients.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of squares of binomial co-efficients.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Central binomial coefficient calculator
Main goal: Compute C(2n, n) using BigInteger by evaluating (2n)! / (n!)^2. The factorial(start, end) helper multiplies all integers in the inclusive range, and sumOfSquare(n) returns the central binomial coefficient (which also equals the sum of squares of the binomial coefficients for n).

mbpp_0801.reference_description: Write a java function to count the number of equal numbers from three given integers.
