Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the number of equal numbers from three given integers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: testThreeEqual - Distinctness-based evaluation for three integers
Main goal: Given three integers x, y, z, determine how many equalities exist among them by inserting them into a HashSet. Return 0 if all are different (set size 3), 2 if two are equal (set size 2), or 3 if all three are equal (set size 1). The function computes 4 - size when not all values are distinct.

mbpp_0578.reference_description: Write a function to interleave arrays of the same length.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to interleave arrays of the same length.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Interleaving Three Lists into One

Main goal: Provide a generic method interleaveLists that takes three lists of equal length and returns a single list by repeatedly taking elements at the same index from each list (list1[i], list2[i], list3[i]), producing a List<T> with 3 * size elements. It uses an ArrayList with initial capacity size * 3. It assumes all three lists are at least as long as the first and does not check lengths, which can lead to IndexOutOfBoundsException if list2 or list3 are shorter.

mbpp_0033.reference_description: Write a java function to convert a decimal number to binary number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to convert a decimal number to binary number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: Return a number whose decimal digits represent the input's binary form. The method repeatedly takes N % 2, places each bit at the corresponding 10^cnt position, and halves N until it becomes 0, yielding a long that encodes the binary digits (e.g., 5 -> 101). Note: this is not a real binary type, may overflow for larger N, and negative inputs aren’t properly handled.

mbpp_0647.reference_description: Write a function to split a string at uppercase letters.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to split a string at uppercase letters.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines a StringSplitter with a method splitUpperString that extracts the CamelCase components of a string. It uses a regex [A-Z][^A-Z]* to find all substrings that start with an uppercase letter followed by zero or more non-uppercase characters, collecting them into a List<String> and returning it. For example, "HelloWorld" becomes ["Hello", "World"].

mbpp_0467.reference_description: Write a java function to convert decimal number to octal number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to convert decimal number to octal number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: DecimalToOctal: Converts a decimal integer to its octal representation by repeatedly dividing by 8 and building a base-10 number whose digits correspond to the octal digits of the input (no negative handling; 0 yields 0; potential overflow for large inputs).

mbpp_0950.reference_description: Write a function to display sign of the chinese zodiac for given year.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to display sign of the chinese zodiac for given year.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Determines the Chinese zodiac sign for a given year by computing the year’s offset from 2000 modulo 12 and returning the corresponding sign from a predefined 12-element array (Dragon for 2000, Snake for 2001, etc.), handling negative years as well.

mbpp_0719.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by zero or more b's.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by zero or more b's.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TextMatch uses a regex to detect a lowercase 'a' in the input.
Main goal: To determine if the given text contains the character 'a' by compiling the pattern "ab*?" (which matches 'a' followed by zero or more 'b's in a non-greedy way) and using Matcher.find(); it returns "Found a match!" if an 'a' exists, otherwise "Not matched!".

mbpp_0670.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether a sequence of numbers has a decreasing trend or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether a sequence of numbers has a decreasing trend or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TrendChecker - Ascending Order Validator
Main goal: Determine if the input list of integers is already sorted in ascending (non-decreasing) order by creating a sorted copy and comparing it to the original; returns true if they are identical, false otherwise.

mbpp_0734.reference_description: Write a java function to find sum of products of all possible subarrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find sum of products of all possible subarrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of products of all contiguous subarrays

Main goal: Compute the total sum of the products of every contiguous subarray of the input array arr (length n). The function processes the array from right to left, maintaining a running value res that represents the sum of products of subarrays starting at the next index. For each index i, it computes incr = arr[i] * (1 + res), adds incr to the total ans, and updates res to incr. The final ans is the sum over all subarray products. Time complexity: O(n); space complexity: O(1) (besides input storage); uses long to handle large sums.

mbpp_0015.reference_description: Write a function to split a string at lowercase letters.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to split a string at lowercase letters.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: StringSplitter - extract lowercase-starting chunks
Main goal: Split an input string into substrings that start with a lowercase letter and continue with non-lowercase characters, returning them as a list via splitLowerString using the regex [a-z][^a-z]*.

mbpp_0056.reference_description: Write a java function to check if a given number is one less than twice its reverse.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check if a given number is one less than twice its reverse.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Digit reversal utility and property checker
Main goal: Determine if a given positive integer n satisfies 2 * reverse(n) == n + 1, using rev to compute reverse(n).
Functions:
- rev(int num): computes the digits of num in reverse order.
- check(int n): returns true if 2 * rev(n) equals n + 1.

mbpp_0024.reference_description: Write a function to convert the given binary number to its decimal equivalent.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert the given binary number to its decimal equivalent.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: BinaryToDecimal Converter
Main goal: Convert an integer whose decimal digits represent a binary number (e.g., 1011) into its decimal value by processing digits from least to most significant and accumulating digit × 2^position.

mbpp_0044.reference_description: Write a function that matches a word at the beginning of a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a word at the beginning of a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TextMatcher - Start-of-string word prefix detector
Main goal: To check whether the input string begins with one or more word characters (letters, digits, underscore) using the regex ^\w+. If such a prefix exists, it returns "Found a match!"; otherwise, it returns "Not matched!".

mbpp_0300.reference_description: Write a function to find the count of all binary sequences of length 2n such that sum of first n bits is same as sum of last n bits.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the count of all binary sequences of length 2n such that sum of first n bits is same as sum of last n bits.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Computes the central binomial coefficient C(2n, n) by iteratively building C(n, r) for r = 0..n and summing C(n, r)^2 (starting with C(n, 0)^2 = 1). The loop updates nCr = C(n, r) and adds nCr^2 to the running total, yielding sum_{r=0}^n C(n, r)^2 = C(2n, n). Uses BigInteger for arbitrary-precision arithmetic.

mbpp_0254.reference_description: Write a function to find all words starting with 'a' or 'e' in a given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find all words starting with 'a' or 'e' in a given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: AEWordsFinder – Extracts lowercase a/e-starting words from text
Main goal: Provide a method wordsAE that scans the input text and returns a list of all lowercase words beginning with 'a' or 'e'. It compiles the regex "[ae]\\w+", uses a Matcher to find all matches, collects them in a List<String>, and returns the list. Note: only lowercase start letters are matched; uppercase words are ignored.

mbpp_0151.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the given number is co-prime or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the given number is co-prime or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The CoprimeChecker class implements Euclidean gcd(p,q) to compute the greatest common divisor of two integers and isCoprime(x,y) to check if they are coprime by testing whether gcd(x,y) == 1.

mbpp_0330.reference_description: Write a function to find all three, four, five characters long words in the given string by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find all three, four, five characters long words in the given string by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: WordFinder - extract 3- to 5-character words
Main goal: Provide a method findChar that returns all words of length 3 to 5 from the given text as a list.
What it does: Uses the regex \b\w{3,5}\b to identify tokens that are 3 to 5 word characters long, iterates matches with a Matcher, and collects each matched substring into a List<String> which is returned. Notes: \w matches letters, digits, and underscore; boundaries ensure whole words; null input will throw NPE; Unicode considerations depend on default pattern flags.

mbpp_0337.reference_description: Write a function that matches a word at the end of a string, with optional punctuation.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a word at the end of a string, with optional punctuation.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Checks if the given text contains a substring ending at the end of the string that matches one or more word characters followed by optional non-space characters; returns "Found a match!" if such a match exists, otherwise "Not matched!".

mbpp_0434.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by one or more b's.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by one or more b's.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: TextMatcher. Main goal: Determine whether a given string contains a substring matching the pattern "a" followed by one or more "b" characters (ab+? using a lazy quantifier) and return "Found a match!" if such a substring exists, otherwise "Not matched!". The textMatchOne method compiles the regex, tests the input with a Matcher, and returns the corresponding message.

mbpp_0406.reference_description: Write a java function to find the parity of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the parity of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: ParityFinder - Determine parity of an integer's set bits
Main goal: Given an int x, compute its bitwise parity using a sequence of XOR-fold operations and return "Odd Parity" if the number of 1s is odd, otherwise "Even Parity".

mbpp_0396.reference_description: Write a function to check whether the given string starts and ends with the same character or not using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check whether the given string starts and ends with the same character or not using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: RegexChecker — lowercase-letter pattern validator
Main goal: Expose a checkChar method that uses a regex to determine if the input is either a single lowercase letter or a string that starts with a lowercase letter and ends with the same letter; it returns "Valid" for matches and "Invalid" otherwise.

mbpp_0482.reference_description: Write a function to find sequences of one upper case letter followed by lower case letters in the given string by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find sequences of one upper case letter followed by lower case letters in the given string by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: RegexMatcher - End-with Uppercase+Lowercase Pattern
Main goal: Provide a method match(text) that returns "Yes" if the input string ends with a sequence of one or more uppercase letters followed by one or more lowercase letters (regex [A-Z]+[a-z]+$); otherwise returns "No". It uses Java's Pattern and Matcher (with find) to check the condition.

mbpp_0563.reference_description: Write a function to extract values between quotation marks of a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract values between quotation marks of a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Extractor
Main goal: Find all substrings enclosed in double quotes in the given text and return them as a List<String> (without the surrounding quotation marks).

mbpp_0573.reference_description: Write a java function to calculate the product of the unique numbers of a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to calculate the product of the unique numbers of a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Computes the product of distinct integers by removing duplicates with a Set, then multiplying the remaining values (starting from 1) and returning the result as a long.

mbpp_0454.reference_description: Write a function that matches a word containing 'z'.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a word containing 'z'.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Java regex pattern matcher
Main goal: To check if a given string contains a substring that matches the regex \w*z.\w* (represented in Java as "\\w*z.\\w*") and return either "Found a match!" or "Not matched!".

mbpp_0737.reference_description: Write a function to check whether the given string is starting with a vowel or not using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check whether the given string is starting with a vowel or not using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Checks if a string starts with a vowel (case-insensitive) followed by letters, digits, or underscores; returns "Valid" if matched, otherwise "Invalid". Note: because the pattern uses ^ but no end anchor and Matcher.find() is used, trailing characters after the initial valid sequence are allowed.

mbpp_0648.reference_description: Write a function to exchange the position of every n-th value with (n+1)th value and (n+1)th value with n-th value in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to exchange the position of every n-th value with (n+1)th value and (n+1)th value with n-th value in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: ExchangeElements
Main goal: Provide a generic method that takes a List<T>, returns a new list where each adjacent pair of elements is swapped (0↔1, 2↔3, etc.). It makes a shallow copy of the input, then swaps elements in pairs in the copy; if the list length is odd, the last element remains unchanged. Time complexity: O(n); Space complexity: O(n).

mbpp_0725.reference_description: Write a function to extract values between quotation marks of the given string by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract values between quotation marks of the given string by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Extracts and returns all substrings enclosed in double quotes from the input text as a list of strings (without the quotes), using a non-greedy regex.

mbpp_0584.reference_description: Write a function to find all adverbs and their positions in a given sentence by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find all adverbs and their positions in a given sentence by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: AdverbFinder
Main goal: Identify words ending with "ly" in a given text using a regex and return a list of strings in the form "start-end: word" that include the match's span and the matched adverb.

mbpp_0756.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by zero or one 'b'.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by zero or one 'b'.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: TextMatcher.java — Main goal: check if a string contains a substring that matches the regex "ab?" (an 'a' optionally followed by 'b'), returning "Found a match!" if found, otherwise "Not matched!".

mbpp_0785.reference_description: Write a function to convert tuple string to integer tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert tuple string to integer tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TupleConverter - Converts a string tuple of integers to an int array
Main goal: Provide a method tupleStrInt that takes a string like "(1, 2, 3)" (also handling "..." and parentheses), strips formatting, splits on ", ", parses each part as an int, and returns the resulting int[] array.

mbpp_0787.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by three 'b'.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by three 'b'.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TextMatcher - regex-based substring detector
Main goal: Provide a method textMatchThree that scans input text for a substring matching the regex "ab{3}?" and returns "Found a match!" if such a substring exists, otherwise "Not matched!".
Notes: Uses Java Pattern and Matcher with find() to locate the first occurrence.

mbpp_0749.reference_description: Write a function to sort a given array of strings of numbers numerically.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to sort a given array of strings of numbers numerically.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Numeric String Sorter
Main goal: Parse a list of numeric strings into integers and return a sorted list of those integers in ascending order.

mbpp_0917.reference_description: Write a function to find the sequences of one upper case letter followed by lower case letters.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the sequences of one upper case letter followed by lower case letters.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: TextUtils.textUppercaseLowercase;Main goal: Use the regex [A-Z]+[a-z]+$ to check if the input contains a trailing uppercase+lowercase segment and return "Found a match!" if found, otherwise "Not matched!".

mbpp_0930.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by zero or more b's by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by zero or more b's by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Simple regex check (RegexMatcher). Goal: Determine whether the input text contains the pattern "ab*?" (an 'a' possibly followed by any number of 'b's); since b*? can be zero, this effectively checks for an 'a' anywhere in the text. If found, textMatch returns "Found a match!", otherwise "Not matched!".

mbpp_0879.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an 'a' followed by anything, ending in 'b' by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a string that has an 'a' followed by anything, ending in 'b' by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: RegexMatcher
Main goal: Check if the input text contains a substring that starts with 'a' and ends with 'b' at the end of the string (regex "a.*?b$"). If such a substring exists, textMatch returns "Found a match!"; otherwise it returns "Not matched!". It uses a static method with Java regex Pattern and Matcher and relies on find() to locate the match.

mbpp_0906.reference_description: Write a function to extract year, month and date from a url by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract year, month and date from a url by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: DateExtractor
Goal: Extracts date components from a URL path by matching patterns like /YYYY/MM/DD/ and returns a list of [year, month, day] strings for each match.

mbpp_0036.reference_description: Write a java function to find the nth digit in the proper fraction of two given numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the nth digit in the proper fraction of two given numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: FractionDigitFinder - N-th digit of p/q's decimal expansion
Main goal: Compute the N-th digit after the decimal point of the fraction p/q by simulating long division: iteratively multiply the current remainder by 10, extract the next digit as quotient, update the remainder, and return the last obtained digit. Assumes non-negative p, q with p < q (and uses 32-bit ints); behavior is incorrect if p >= q for the first digit.

mbpp_0088.reference_description: Write a function to get the frequency of the elements in array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to get the frequency of the elements in array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: FrequencyCounter - Count element frequencies
Main goal: Provide a generic method freqCount(List<T>) that returns a map of each list item to its number of occurrences.

mbpp_0251.reference_description: Write a function to insert an element before each element of array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to insert an element before each element of array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Interleave a given element before each item in a list
Main goal: Return a new list where the provided element is inserted before every element of the input list. For input [a, b, c] and element x, the result is [x, a, x, b, x, c]. The method is generic, non-mutating (does not modify the input list), and returns a new List<T>.

mbpp_0273.reference_description: Write a function to substract the contents of one tuple with corresponding index of other tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to substract the contents of one tuple with corresponding index of other tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Element-wise subtraction of two integer lists
Main goal: Compute a new list containing the element-wise differences of two input lists, up to the length of the shorter list.
How it works: It takes the minimum of the two list sizes, iterates from 0 to that size, and for each index adds list1.get(i) - list2.get(i) to the result, which is returned.

mbpp_0314.reference_description: Write a function to find out the maximum sum such that no two chosen numbers are adjacent for the given rectangular grid of dimension 2 x n.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find out the maximum sum such that no two chosen numbers are adjacent for the given rectangular grid of dimension 2 x n.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Max Sum in a 2xN Grid with Non-Adjacent Columns

Main goal: Given a 2xN grid, compute the maximum possible sum by selecting a subset of columns such that no two chosen columns are adjacent, and for each selected column add the larger of its two values. The algorithm uses a dynamic programming approach with two states: incl (best sum including the current column) and excl (best sum excluding it), scanning across columns. Time complexity: O(n); space complexity: O(1).

mbpp_0320.reference_description: Write a function to calculate the difference between the squared sum of first n natural numbers and the sum of squared first n natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to calculate the difference between the squared sum of first n natural numbers and the sum of squared first n natural numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code computes the difference between the square of the sum and the sum of squares of the integers from 1 to n. It iterates to accumulate sumOfSquares (sum of i^2) and squareOfSum (sum of i), then returns (sum i)^2 − sum i^2 as a long. Time complexity O(n); uses long to prevent overflow.

mbpp_0319.reference_description: Write a function to find all five characters long word in the given string by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find all five characters long word in the given string by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Extract five-character words
Main goal: The code defines StringUtil.findLongWord which returns a list of all five-character word tokens found in the input text. It uses the regex \b\w{5}\b to match sequences of exactly five word characters (letters, digits, underscore) bounded by word boundaries, and collects them in the order they appear.

mbpp_0285.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by two to three 'b'.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a string that has an a followed by two to three 'b'.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Java class TextMatcher provides textMatchTwoThree(String text) which uses the regex "ab{2,3}" to check if the input contains an 'a' followed by two or three 'b's (i.e., "abb" or "abbb"). If a match is found, it returns "Found a match!"; otherwise it returns "Not matched!".

mbpp_0643.reference_description: Write a function that matches a word containing 'z', not at the start or end of the word.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a word containing 'z', not at the start or end of the word.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TextMatcher — Non-boundary "z" detector
Main goal: Determine if the input text contains a lowercase 'z' that is not at a word boundary (i.e., a 'z' inside a word) using the regex \Bz\B; returns "Found a match!" if such a character exists, otherwise "Not matched!".

mbpp_0539.reference_description: Write a function to create array containing the power of said number in bases raised to the corresponding number in the index using map function.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to create array containing the power of said number in bases raised to the corresponding number in the index using map function.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Pairwise exponentiation of corresponding elements. Main goal: Given two lists of doubles, produce a new list where result[i] = basesNum[i]^(index[i]), computed up to the shorter list length (extra elements in the longer list are ignored).

mbpp_0444.reference_description: Write a function to trim each tuple by k in the given tuple array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to trim each tuple by k in the given tuple array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Given a list of lists of T, trimTuple removes K elements from the start and K from the end of every inner list, collects the trimmed lists into a new list, and returns the string representation of that resulting list. It uses subList(K, N-K) for each inner list; if any inner list has size < 2K, an exception is thrown. The method is static and generic over T.

mbpp_0656.reference_description: Write a java function to find the minimum sum of absolute differences of two arrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the minimum sum of absolute differences of two arrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sorting-based minimal sum of absolute differences
Main goal: Sort both input arrays a and b, then compute and return the sum of the absolute differences of corresponding elements, i.e., sum |a[i] - b[i]| for i from 0 to n-1.

mbpp_0759.reference_description: Write a function to check a decimal with a precision of 2.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check a decimal with a precision of 2.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: DecimalUtils - Validate decimal numbers with up to two decimal places
Main goal: Expose isDecimal(String num) to check if a non-null string represents a whole number or a number with a fractional part containing 1 or 2 digits, using a precompiled regex pattern.

mbpp_0794.reference_description: Write a function that matches a string that has an 'a' followed by anything, ending in 'b'.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that matches a string that has an 'a' followed by anything, ending in 'b'.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TextMatcher - Regex-based substring check
Main goal: Provide a static method textStartAEndB that checks whether the given text contains a substring matching the pattern a.*?b$ (an 'a' followed by any characters non-greedily and ending with 'b' at the end of the string) and returns "Found a match!" if it matches, otherwise "Not matched!".

mbpp_0674.reference_description: Write a function to remove duplicate words from a given string using collections module.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to remove duplicate words from a given string using collections module.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: RemoveDuplicateWords (Java)
Main goal: Remove duplicate words from a string while preserving the original word order.
How: Splits the input on whitespace, inserts words into a LinkedHashSet to ensure uniqueness while maintaining insertion order, and then joins the words back with spaces.

mbpp_0740.reference_description: Write a function to convert the given tuple to a key-value map using adjacent elements.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert the given tuple to a key-value map using adjacent elements.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Transforms a List<Object> that represents alternating key/value pairs (k1, v1, k2, v2, …) into a Map<Object, Object> by iterating in steps of two and inserting each pair as a map entry. Assumes the input list has even length; duplicates will overwrite earlier values; potential issues include null input or odd-length lists causing an exception.

mbpp_0019.reference_description: Write a function to find whether a given array of integers contains any duplicate element.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find whether a given array of integers contains any duplicate element.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: DuplicateChecker
Main goal: Determine if an int[] has duplicates by adding elements to a HashSet and comparing the array length to the set's size; returns true if duplicates exist.

mbpp_0944.reference_description: Write a function to separate and print the numbers and their position of a given string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to separate and print the numbers and their position of a given string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Locate the starting index of the first numeric sequence in a string
Main goal: The numPosition method uses a regex to find the first sequence of digits in the input text and returns its starting index as an Integer; if there are no digits, it returns null.

mbpp_0956.reference_description: Write a function to split the given string at uppercase letters by using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to split the given string at uppercase letters by using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Analyzes a CamelCase/PascalCase string and splits it into its constituent words by matching segments that start with an uppercase letter and continue with non-uppercase characters, returning them as a List<String>. It uses the regex [A-Z][^A-Z]* and has no null-check for the input.

mbpp_0016.reference_description: Write a function to find sequences of lowercase letters joined with an underscore.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find sequences of lowercase letters joined with an underscore.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Two-lowercase-words-with-underscore validator
Main goal: Provide a utility method textLowercaseUnderscore that returns "Found a match!" when the input string exactly matches the pattern of two sequences of lowercase letters separated by a single underscore (regex ^[a-z]+_[a-z]+$); otherwise it returns "Not matched!". It compiles the pattern inside the method and checks the entire string via anchors.

mbpp_0043.reference_description: Write a function to find sequences of lowercase letters joined with an underscore using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find sequences of lowercase letters joined with an underscore using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TextMatcher regex-based string validator
Main goal: To check if a given string matches the pattern "^[a-z]+_[a-z]+$" (two lowercase letter sequences separated by an underscore) and return "Found a match!" if it does or "Not matched!" otherwise.

mbpp_0021.reference_description: Write a function to find m number of multiples of n.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find m number of multiples of n.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Multiples class – first m multiples of a number
Main goal: Implement multiplesOfNum(int m, int n) to return a List<Integer> containing the first m multiples of n (n, 2n, ..., mn). If m <= 0, returns an empty list.

mbpp_0027.reference_description: Write a java function to remove all digits from array of strings.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to remove all digits from array of strings.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Digit-stripping list transformer
Main goal: Return a new List<String> where each input string has all numeric digits removed by replacing digits with empty strings.

mbpp_0049.reference_description: Write a function to extract every first or specified element from a given two-dimensional array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract every first or specified element from a given two-dimensional array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Column extraction from a 2D list. Main goal: Return a list containing the N-th element from each inner list (i.e., extract the N-th column from a list of rows). Assumes zero-based indexing and may throw IndexOutOfBoundsException if a row is too short.

mbpp_0154.reference_description: Write a function to extract every specified element from a given two dimensional array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract every specified element from a given two dimensional array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: SpecifiedElementExtractor. Goal: Given a List<List<T>> and an index N, return a List<T> containing the N-th element of every inner list (i.get(N)); assumes all inner lists have at least N+1 elements (and are non-null), otherwise may throw IndexOutOfBoundsException.

mbpp_0156.reference_description: Write a function to convert a tuple of string values to a tuple of integer values.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert a tuple of string values to a tuple of integer values.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TupleConverter - String-to-Int Tuple Conversion
Main goal: Convert a List<String[]> (where each inner array contains at least two numeric strings) into a List<int[]> by parsing the first two elements of each inner array as integers; returns the list of int arrays. Note: potential exceptions if an inner array has fewer than two elements or contains non-numeric strings.

mbpp_0145.reference_description: Write a java function to find the maximum difference between any two elements in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the maximum difference between any two elements in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Max Absolute Difference
Goal: For a given int array arr of length n, compute the maximum absolute difference between any two elements by finding the minimum and maximum values in arr and returning maxEle - minEle.

mbpp_0203.reference_description: Write a java function to find the hamming distance between given two integers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the hamming distance between given two integers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Hamming Distance Calculator for Integers
Main goal: Compute the number of differing bits between two integers by XOR-ing them and counting the 1s in the result.

mbpp_0236.reference_description: Write a java function to count the maximum number of equilateral triangles that can be formed within a given equilateral triangle.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the maximum number of equilateral triangles that can be formed within a given equilateral triangle.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TriangleCounter: counts triangles using two triangular-number terms
Main goal: Compute the total number of triangles based on N and K by summing two triangular numbers; returns -1 if N < K.
Notes: triUp = (N-K+1)*(N-K+2)/2 = T_{N-K+1}, triDown = (N-2K+1)*(N-2K+2)/2 = T_{N-2K+1}, where T_m = m*(m+1)/2.

mbpp_0345.reference_description: Write a function to find the difference between two consecutive numbers in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the difference between two consecutive numbers in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Consecutive Differences Calculator
Main goal: Compute the differences between each pair of consecutive numbers in the input list. The static method diffConsecutiveNums takes a List<Integer> nums and returns a new List<Integer> where each element is nums.get(i+1) - nums.get(i) for i from 0 to size()-2. If the input has fewer than 2 elements, it returns an empty list.

mbpp_0205.reference_description: Write a function to find the inversions of tuple elements in the given tuple array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the inversions of tuple elements in the given tuple array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Bitwise inversion of a list of integers
Main goal: The method inversionElements takes a List<Integer> and returns a new List<Integer> containing the bitwise complement (~) of each input value, by iterating through the input and adding ~x to the result.

mbpp_0206.reference_description: Write a function to perform the adjacent element concatenation in the given tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to perform the adjacent element concatenation in the given tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Concatenator - concatenate adjacent strings
Main goal: Given a list of strings, return a new list where each element is the concatenation of two consecutive elements from the input (i and i+1). The result size is input size minus one; if there are fewer than 2 elements, the result is empty. The method iterates with a for loop and builds the result list.

mbpp_0419.reference_description: Write a function to round every number of a given array of numbers and print the total sum multiplied by the length of the array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to round every number of a given array of numbers and print the total sum multiplied by the length of the array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Round-and-Sum Processor
Main goal: For a given List<Double>, round each element to the nearest integer, sum these rounded values, and multiply the sum by the list size, returning the result as a long.

mbpp_0372.reference_description: Write a function to sort a given array of elements in ascending order using heap queue algorithm.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to sort a given array of elements in ascending order using heap queue algorithm.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Ascending-order sorting via PriorityQueue
Main goal: Return a new list containing the input elements in ascending order by inserting them into a min-heap (PriorityQueue) and polling the smallest element repeatedly. The method does not modify the input list and uses generics (T extends Comparable).

mbpp_0424.reference_description: Write a function to extract only the rear index element of each string in the given tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract only the rear index element of each string in the given tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: It provides a utility method extractRear(List<String>) that returns a list containing the last character of each string in the input list by iterating over the list and taking s.charAt(s.length() - 1); note that it does not handle empty or null strings.

mbpp_0368.reference_description: Write a function to repeat the given tuple n times.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to repeat the given tuple n times.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TupleRepeater.repeatTuples creates N references to the same input list
Main goal: Given a List<T> testTup and an int N, it returns a List<List<T>> of size N where every element is the same List<T> testTup (no cloning). This can cause shared-state side effects since all entries reference the same list.

mbpp_0460.reference_description: Write a java function to get the first element of each sublist.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to get the first element of each sublist.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Extractor
Main goal: Convert a List<List<T>> into a List<T> by collecting the first element from each inner list (item.get(0)).

mbpp_0503.reference_description: Write a function to add consecutive numbers of a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to add consecutive numbers of a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Consecutive Pair Sum Utility
Main goal: Given a list of integers, return a new list where each element is the sum of two adjacent elements from the input (nums[i] + nums[i+1]). The resulting list has length input.size() - 1 and the original list remains unchanged.

mbpp_0456.reference_description: Write a function to reverse strings in a given array of string values.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to reverse strings in a given array of string values.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Reverse strings in a list
Main goal: Given a list of strings, produce a new list where each string is reversed.
How it works: The method reverseStringList creates an empty result list, iterates over the input strings, reverses each one using new StringBuilder(s).reverse().toString(), adds the reversed string to the result, and returns the result. It does not modify the input list and will throw a NullPointerException if any element is null.

mbpp_0433.reference_description: Write a function to check whether the entered number is greater than the elements of the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check whether the entered number is greater than the elements of the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines a Checker class with a static method checkGreater that takes an int array and a number, sorts the array in place, and checks if the number is greater than the array’s largest element. It returns a message indicating whether the number is greater than all elements in the array. Note: it mutates the input array, and will throw an exception if the array is empty; the else branch’s message can be misleading for certain values (e.g., equal to the max).

mbpp_0547.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of hamming distances of all consecutive numbers from o to n.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of hamming distances of all consecutive numbers from o to n.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Total Hamming Distance Across Pairs in 0..n
Main goal: Compute the sum of floor(n / 2^k) for k = 0,1,2,... by iterating over powers of two (i = 1, 2, 4, ...) and accumulating n / i, effectively returning a value used to represent the total bit-differences among all pairs of integers in the inclusive range [0, n].

mbpp_0543.reference_description: Write a function to add two numbers and print number of digits of sum.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to add two numbers and print number of digits of sum.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: CountDigits
Main goal: Compute the number of decimal digits in the sum of two integers by adding them and counting digits through repeated division by 10; note it only handles positive sums correctly and may return 0 for zero/negative sums and is subject to integer overflow if the sum exceeds int range.

mbpp_0529.reference_description: Write a function to find the nth jacobsthal-lucas number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the nth jacobsthal-lucas number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Jacobsthal-Lucas Number Calculator
Main goal: Compute the nth Jacobsthal-Lucas number using dynamic programming. It builds a dp array with base cases J0=2, J1=1 and recurrence Jn = Jn-1 + 2*Jn-2, returning Jn.

mbpp_0536.reference_description: Write a function to select the nth items of array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to select the nth items of array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Main goal: Given a list, produce a new list containing every nth element, starting from index 0 (indices 0, n, 2n, ...). Note: the code does not guard against non-positive n, which can cause issues.

mbpp_0565.reference_description: Write a java function to split a string into characters.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to split a string into characters.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Split string into a list of single-character strings
Main goal: Provide a utility method StringUtils.split(String word) that converts a given string into a List<String>, where each element is the string representation of one character from the input (i.e., a list of one-character strings). The method iterates over the characters and appends String.valueOf(c) to the list; it does not handle null inputs.

mbpp_0551.reference_description: Write a function to extract a specified column from a given nested array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract a specified column from a given nested array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Extractor.extractColumn
Main goal: Remove the nth element from each inner list in a List<List<T>> and return a list containing those removed elements (i.e., extract the nth column). The input is mutated (rows lose their nth element). May throw IndexOutOfBoundsException if any row is too short (and NPE if inputs are null).

mbpp_0724.reference_description: Write a function to calculate the sum of all digits of the base to the specified power.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to calculate the sum of all digits of the base to the specified power.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
PowerBaseSum: Sum of digits of base^power

Goal: Compute the sum of decimal digits of base raised to the given power. It uses BigInteger to safely compute base^power, converts the result to a string, sums the numeric value of each digit, and returns the total as an int.

mbpp_0690.reference_description: Write a function to multiply consecutive numbers of a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to multiply consecutive numbers of a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: produce a new list containing the product of every pair of consecutive numbers in the input list. For a list of size n, it returns n-1 values where each is nums[i] * nums[i+1] (i from 0 to n-2). Returns an empty list if the input has fewer than two elements. No null checks are performed; potential NullPointerException if input is null. Time complexity: O(n).

mbpp_0728.reference_description: Write a function to sum elements in two arrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to sum elements in two arrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Utility class ListUtils provides sumList, which takes two Lists of Integers, adds corresponding elements pairwise, and returns a new List of the sums (assuming both input lists have the same length and are non-null).

mbpp_0825.reference_description: Write a java function to access multiple elements of specified index from a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to access multiple elements of specified index from a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Generic element selector by indices
Main goal: Implement a generic method accessElements that takes a list of elements and a list of indices and returns a new list containing the elements at those indices, in the order specified by the indices. It does not perform bounds checking.

mbpp_0763.reference_description: Write a java function to find the minimum difference between any two elements in a given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the minimum difference between any two elements in a given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: MinDiffFinder - Compute the smallest gap after sorting
Main goal: Sort the input integer array and return the minimum difference between any two consecutive elements (the smallest adjacent gap).

mbpp_0774.reference_description: Write a function to check if the string is a valid email address or not using regex.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if the string is a valid email address or not using regex.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Simple Email Validator
Main goal: Validate an email string using a basic regular expression and return a fixed status message.
Functionality:
- Defines a regex (REGEX) for a simplistic email format: lowercase letters/digits, optional single dot or underscore in the local part, an @, followed by word characters, a dot, and a 2–3 character TLD.
- checkEmail(String email): Uses Pattern.matches with REGEX to return "Valid Email" if the input matches, otherwise "Invalid Email".

mbpp_0076.reference_description: Write a java function to count the number of squares in a rectangle.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the number of squares in a rectangle.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Total number of squares in an m-by-n grid
Goal: Compute the total number of axis-aligned squares that can be formed in an m × n rectangle. The method ensures m ≤ n (swapping if needed) and returns the closed-form m(m+1)(3n − m + 1)/6, which equals the sum over all square sizes of (m − k + 1)(n − k + 1).

mbpp_0098.reference_description: Write a function to multiply all the numbers in array and divide with the length of the array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to multiply all the numbers in array and divide with the length of the array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Calculates the product of all numbers in the input list and then divides that product by the list size, effectively returning (product of elements) / n. This is not a true geometric mean (which would use the nth root) and may yield Infinity or NaN for empty lists; it can also throw a NullPointerException if the list contains nulls.

mbpp_0116.reference_description: Write a function to convert a given tuple of positive integers into an integer.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert a given tuple of positive integers into an integer.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TupleToIntUtil — Concatenate integers into a BigInteger
Main goal: Convert an array of integers into a single BigInteger by concatenating their decimal representations.
Explanation: The method builds a string by appending each number in nums, then constructs and returns a BigInteger from that string.

mbpp_0902.reference_description: Write a function to combine two maps by adding values for common keys.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to combine two maps by adding values for common keys.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Merges two maps from K to Integer by summing values for overlapping keys and returns a new map; copies d1 into a new result and adds each entry from d2, using 0 as the default for missing keys.

mbpp_0224.reference_description: Write a java function to count set bits of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count set bits of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: BitCounter — Counts set bits in an integer
Main goal: Expose countSetBits(int n) that returns how many 1s are in the binary representation of n by repeatedly adding (n & 1) to a counter and shifting n right until it becomes 0. Note: this assumes n is non-negative; for negative values, the arithmetic right shift can cause an infinite loop.

mbpp_0261.reference_description: Write a function to perform mathematical division operation across the given tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to perform mathematical division operation across the given tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Element-wise integer division of two arrays
Main goal: Return a new int[] where each element is the result of dividing testTup1[i] by testTup2[i] for i from 0 to min(testTup1.length, testTup2.length) - 1 (integer division). The output length matches the shorter input; potential division by zero is not handled.

mbpp_0197.reference_description: Write a function to perform the exponentiation of the given two tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to perform the exponentiation of the given two tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Element-wise exponentiation of two double arrays
Main goal: Given two double arrays, compute a new array where each element is the corresponding element of the first array raised to the power of the corresponding element of the second array. The operation is performed up to the minimum length of the two inputs (i.e., extra elements in the longer array are ignored), using Math.pow.

mbpp_0213.reference_description: Write a function to perform the concatenation of two string tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to perform the concatenation of two string tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: StringConcatenator - Concatenate corresponding elements of two string arrays
Main goal: Given two String arrays, return a new array where each element i is the concatenation of testTup1[i] and testTup2[i], up to the length of the shorter array. It computes the minimum length, iterates over that range, concatenates the pairs, and returns the result.

mbpp_0271.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of fifth power of first n even natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of fifth power of first n even natural numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: EvenPowerSum - Sum of fifth powers of the first n even numbers.
Goal: Given n, compute the sum of (2i)^5 for i = 1 to n and return it as a long.
What it does: Iterates i from 1 to n, computes j = 2*i as a long, computes j^5 by repeated multiplications, accumulates the result in sum, and returns sum.
Complexity: Time O(n), Space O(1).

mbpp_0347.reference_description: Write a java function to count the number of squares in a rectangle.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the number of squares in a rectangle.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Count square submatrices in an m x n grid
Main goal: Return the number of square submatrices within an m-by-n matrix by using a closed-form formula after swapping to ensure m <= n. The standard correct formula is m*(m+1)*(3n - m + 1)/6; the code uses n*(n+1)*(3m - n + 1)/6 which may be incorrect for some inputs.

mbpp_0365.reference_description: Write a java function to count the number of digits of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to count the number of digits of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: DigitCounter - Decimal Digit Counter
Main goal: Count how many decimal digits are in a given integer by repeatedly dividing by 10 until the value becomes 0; the function returns the number of divisions performed.
Notes: 
- For positive numbers, the result equals the number of digits.
- For 0, the function returns 0 (an edge case since 0 has one digit).
- For negative numbers, the sign is ignored and the count corresponds to the digits in the absolute value.

mbpp_0399.reference_description: Write a function to perform the mathematical bitwise xor operation across the given tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to perform the mathematical bitwise xor operation across the given tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Computes the element-wise bitwise XOR of two int arrays up to the length of the shorter array and returns a new array with the results.

mbpp_0439.reference_description: Write a function to convert array of multiple integers into a single integer.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert array of multiple integers into a single integer.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Concatenate a list of integers into a single integer
Main goal: Take a list of integers, concatenate their decimal representations without separators, and parse the result as a single int (e.g., [1, 2, 3] -> 123). Uses StringBuilder to accumulate and Integer.parseInt to convert. Note: may fail for negative numbers or values that exceed the int range.

mbpp_0420.reference_description: Write a java function to find the cube sum of first n even natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the cube sum of first n even natural numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: CubeSum - sum of cubes of the first n even numbers
Main goal: Compute the sum of (2*i)^3 for i = 1 to n.
How it works: Iterate i from 1 to n, compute even = 2*i, and accumulate sum += even^3; return sum.
Notes: Time complexity O(n), space complexity O(1); potential integer overflow for large n; closed-form result equals 2*n^2*(n+1)^2.

mbpp_0429.reference_description: Write a function to extract the elementwise and tuples from the given two tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to extract the elementwise and tuples from the given two tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Element-wise bitwise AND for two int arrays
Main goal: Return a new int array where each element is the bitwise AND of the corresponding elements from the two input arrays, up to the length of the shorter array (i.e., min(testTup1.length, testTup2.length)).
Notes: No null checks are performed; will throw NPE if inputs are null. Time complexity: O(n); Space complexity: O(n) for the resulting array.

mbpp_0422.reference_description: Write a java function to find the average of cubes of first n natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the average of cubes of first n natural numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Average of cubes from 1 to n with six-decimal rounding
Main goal: Compute the average of i^3 for i = 1..n using a loop, then round the result to six decimal places and return it.

mbpp_0449.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the triangle is valid or not if 3 points are given.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the triangle is valid or not if 3 points are given.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Triangle existence checker. Goal: Determine if three 2D points form a non-degenerate triangle by computing twice the signed area a = x1(y2−y3) + x2(y3−y1) + x3(y1−y2). If a == 0, the points are collinear and it returns "No"; otherwise it returns "Yes".

mbpp_0500.reference_description: Write a function to concatenate all elements of the given array into a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to concatenate all elements of the given array into a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code defines a class Concatenator with a static method concatenateElements(List<String> list) that builds a string by starting with a single space and then appending a space and each element of the list. The result is a space-delimited string with a leading space (empty list yields one space). It does not handle a null list; using String.join(" ", list) would be a cleaner alternative.

mbpp_0470.reference_description: Write a function to find the pairwise addition of the elements of the given tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the pairwise addition of the elements of the given tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code computes the sums of adjacent elements in an input int array. Given testTup of length n, it returns a new int array res of length n-1 where res[i] = testTup[i] + testTup[i+1].

mbpp_0494.reference_description: Write a function to convert the given binary tuple to integer.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert the given binary tuple to integer.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: BinaryArrayToDecimalString — Converts an array of 0/1 digits into its decimal representation as a string. It concatenates the digits to form a binary string, parses it as base-2 to an int, and returns the decimal value as a string. Assumes all elements are 0 or 1 and may throw on invalid input or overflow.

mbpp_0616.reference_description: Write a function to perfom the modulo of tuple elements in the given two tuples.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to perfom the modulo of tuple elements in the given two tuples.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TupleModulo - Element-wise Modulo of Two Arrays
Main goal: Compute an element-wise modulo of two int arrays up to the length of the shorter array, returning a new array where res[i] = testTup1[i] % testTup2[i].

mbpp_0558.reference_description: Write a java function to find the digit distance between two integers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the digit distance between two integers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: DigitDistance - Sum of digits of absolute difference
Main goal: Given two integers n1 and n2, compute the absolute difference |n1 - n2| and return the sum of its decimal digits.

mbpp_0549.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of fifth power of first n odd natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of fifth power of first n odd natural numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Calculates the sum of the fifth powers of the first n odd numbers (1^5 + 3^5 + 5^5 + ... + (2n-1)^5) and returns the result as a long. Iterates n times, computing each odd number as 2*i-1 and accumulating j^5 in sm.

mbpp_0634.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of fourth power of first n even natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of fourth power of first n even natural numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: EvenPowerSum
Main goal: Compute the sum of the fourth powers of the first n even integers (sum of (2i)^4 for i = 1..n) and return the result as a long.

mbpp_0673.reference_description: Write a java function to convert array of multiple integers into a single integer.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to convert array of multiple integers into a single integer.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Converter; Main goal: Convert a List<Integer> into a single int by concatenating the string representations of the elements in order and parsing the result as an int.

mbpp_0686.reference_description: Write a function to find the frequency of each element in the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find the frequency of each element in the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Counts occurrences of each element in a generic list and returns a string representation of a map from element to its frequency. It builds the counts using a HashMap with getOrDefault, then returns the map's toString().

mbpp_0715.reference_description: Write a function to convert the given string of integers into a tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert the given string of integers into a tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Converts a string of integers separated by ", " into an int[] by splitting on ", " and parsing each token with Integer.parseInt.

mbpp_0677.reference_description: Write a function to check if the triangle is valid or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check if the triangle is valid or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: TriangleValidator - Angle sum based validator
Main goal: Return true if a, b, c sum to 180 (valid triangle angles); otherwise false. It does not validate angle positivity or triangle side inequalities.

mbpp_0768.reference_description: Write a java function to check for odd parity of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check for odd parity of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: ParityChecker.checkOddParity
Goal: Determine if an integer has odd parity by counting the number of set bits (using Brian Kernighan’s method) and returning true when that count is odd, false otherwise.

mbpp_0782.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of all odd length subarrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of all odd length subarrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of all odd-length subarray sums
Main goal: Compute the total sum of sums of all subarrays with odd length for the input array by weighting each element a[i] by the number of odd-length subarrays that include it (ceil((i+1)*(n-i)/2)).

mbpp_0770.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of fourth power of first n odd natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of fourth power of first n odd natural numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Sum of fourth powers of first n odd numbers
Main goal: Compute the sum of the fourth powers of the first n positive odd integers, returning the result as a long.
How it works: For i from 1 to n, it takes the i-th odd number j = 2*i - 1, adds j^4 to a running total, and returns the total.

mbpp_0761.reference_description: Write a function to caluclate arc length of an angle.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to caluclate arc length of an angle.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Goal: Compute the arc length of a circle from its diameter d and central angle a (in degrees) using an approximate pi (22/7). The method ArcLengthCalculator.arcLength(d, a) returns null if a >= 360; otherwise it returns arcLength = (pi * d) * (a / 360.0).

mbpp_0855.reference_description: Write a java function to check for even parity of a given number.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check for even parity of a given number.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: ParityChecker.checkEvenParity
Main goal: Determine whether an integer has even parity by counting the number of set bits. It uses Brian Kernighan's trick (x = x & (x - 1)) to clear the least-significant 1 bit in a loop, increments a counter, and returns true if the count of 1 bits is even.

mbpp_0837.reference_description: Write a java function to find the cube sum of first n odd natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the cube sum of first n odd natural numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: CubeSum — Sum of cubes of the first n odd numbers
Main goal: Compute sum_{i=0}^{n-1} (2i+1)^3 using a simple loop (O(n) time, O(1) space).

mbpp_0827.reference_description: Write a function to sum a specific column of array in a given array of arrays.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to sum a specific column of array in a given array of arrays.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: SumUtils.sumColumn — Sum a specific column in a 2D list
Main goal: Given a List<List<Integer>> representing rows of integers and a column index C, compute and return the sum of all elements in that column by iterating each row and accumulating row.get(C).

mbpp_0886.reference_description: Write a function to add all the numbers in array and divide it with the length of the array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to add all the numbers in array and divide it with the length of the array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Compute the average of a list of doubles
Main goal: Given a List<Double>, sum all elements and divide by the count to return the arithmetic mean. Note: the method is named sumNum but actually computes the average; empty lists yield NaN due to division by zero.

mbpp_0954.reference_description: Write a function that gives profit amount if the given amount has profit else return none.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function that gives profit amount if the given amount has profit else return none.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: ProfitCalculator - computes loss amount when cost exceeds sale price
Main goal: Provide a method profitAmount(int actualCost, int saleAmount) that returns (actualCost - saleAmount) as an Integer only if actualCost > saleAmount; otherwise it returns null. In other words, it reports the loss on a sale, not a profit.

mbpp_0921.reference_description: Write a function to perform chunking of tuples each of size n.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to perform chunking of tuples each of size n.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: ChunkUtil.chunkTuples splits a list into consecutive chunks of size N and returns them as a list of sublists. Each chunk contains up to N elements (the last may be smaller). It iterates over the input list in steps of N, takes a subList from i to min(i+N, size), copies it into a new ArrayList, and collects these chunks into the result. Note: N should be positive to avoid an infinite loop; the method copies each chunk to decouple from the original list.

mbpp_0894.reference_description: Write a function to convert the given string of float type into tuple.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to convert the given string of float type into tuple.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Float string to float array converter
Main goal: A utility that converts a comma-separated numeric string (with optional whitespace after commas) into a float array by splitting the string on ",\\s*" and parsing each token with Float.parseFloat.

mbpp_0919.reference_description: Write a java function to multiply all items in the array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to multiply all items in the array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: Multiply list elements. Main goal: Compute the product of all integers in a list. The Utils.multiplyList method initializes a running total to 1 and multiplies each element of the provided List<Integer>, returning the final product (empty list yields 1). It does not handle null inputs; time complexity is O(n).

mbpp_0138.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the given number can be represented as sum of non-zero powers of 2 or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the given number can be represented as sum of non-zero powers of 2 or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Parity check function
Main goal: Determine if the input n is even; the method returns true for even numbers and false for odd numbers, effectively checking parity rather than actually summing powers of two.

mbpp_0959.reference_description: Write a java function to find the average of array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the average of array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: AverageCalculator. Main goal: compute the arithmetic mean of a list of Double values using average(List<Double>), which sums all elements and divides by the list size; note: does not handle empty lists or nulls.

mbpp_0119.reference_description: Write a java function to find the element that appears only once in a sorted array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the element that appears only once in a sorted array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Compute XOR of first n elements
Main goal: Return the bitwise XOR of the first n elements of the given array.
Functions:
- search(arr, n): initializes XOR to 0; iterates i from 0 to n-1, applies XOR with arr[i], and returns the result.

mbpp_0053.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the first and last characters of a given string are equal or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the first and last characters of a given string are equal or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: StringUtils.checkEquality
Main goal: Determine whether the first and last characters of the input string are the same, returning "Equal" when they match and "Not Equal" otherwise. Note: It does not handle null or empty strings and may throw exceptions for them.

mbpp_0162.reference_description: Write a function to calculate the sum of the positive integers of n+(n-2)+(n-4)... (until n-x =< 0).

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to calculate the sum of the positive integers of n+(n-2)+(n-4)... (until n-x =< 0).
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Recursive sum of numbers with the same parity as n
Main goal: Compute the sum n + (n-2) + (n-4) + ... down to 1 (if n is odd) or 2 (if n is even).
How it works: sumSeries(n) returns 0 if n < 1; otherwise it returns n + sumSeries(n-2), recursively accumulating every second integer starting from n.
Notes: If n is even (n=2k), result = k(k+1); if n is odd (n=2k+1), result = (k+1)². Time and recursion depth are O(n/2).

mbpp_0144.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of absolute differences in all pairs of the given array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of absolute differences in all pairs of the given array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Calculates a weighted sum of the array elements by multiplying arr[i] with (2*i - (n-1)) and summing the results, returning a long. It computes sum_{i=0}^{n-1} arr[i]*(2i - n + 1) in O(n) time and O(1) space (assuming n == arr.length).

mbpp_0177.reference_description: Write a java function to find two distinct numbers such that their lcm lies within the given range.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find two distinct numbers such that their lcm lies within the given range.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Find a pair (a, 2a) within [L, R]
Main goal: Check if the interval [L, R] contains two numbers where the second is twice the first. If 2*L <= R, return [L, 2*L]; otherwise return [-1].

mbpp_0170.reference_description: Write a function to find sum of the numbers in array between the indices of a specified range.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to find sum of the numbers in array between the indices of a specified range.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: The code implements sumRangeList, which returns the sum of array elements from index m through n (inclusive). It uses a straightforward loop to accumulate list1[i] into sumRange and returns the result; there is no bounds checking, so invalid indices may throw an exception, and if m > n it returns 0.

mbpp_0242.reference_description: Write a function to count total characters in a string.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to count total characters in a string.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: CharacterCounter
Main goal: Return the number of characters in a given string by iterating through its characters (manual count; equivalent to str.length()).

mbpp_0248.reference_description: Write a function to calculate the harmonic sum of n-1.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to calculate the harmonic sum of n-1.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: HarmonicSum - recursive computation of the nth harmonic number
Main goal: Compute H_n = 1 + 1/2 + ... + 1/n using recursion.
Function: harmonicSum(int n) returns the sum; base case n < 2 yields 1.0; otherwise adds 1.0/n to harmonicSum(n-1).

mbpp_0212.reference_description: Write a java function to find the sum of fourth power of n natural numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the sum of fourth power of n natural numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: FourthPowerSum
Main goal: Compute the sum of fourth powers from 1 to n (i^4 for i = 1..n) and return it as a long.

mbpp_0281.reference_description: Write a java function to check if the elements of a given array are unique or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check if the elements of a given array are unique or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Checks if all elements in the input list are unique by comparing the list size to the size of a HashSet created from the list; returns true if no duplicates exist, otherwise false.

mbpp_0336.reference_description: Write a function to check whether the given month name contains 28 days or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to check whether the given month name contains 28 days or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Title: February Month Checker. Goal: Provides a static method checkMonthNum in MonthUtils that returns true only if the input string exactly equals "February"; otherwise it returns false.

mbpp_0353.reference_description: Write a function to remove a specified column from a given nested array.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a function to remove a specified column from a given nested array.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Remove a column from a 2D list
Main goal: Remove the nth element from every inner list in a List<List<T>> and return the same (mutated) list.

mbpp_0309.reference_description: Write a java function to find the maximum of two numbers.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to find the maximum of two numbers.
Description_Simple.comparison_text: Computes the maximum of two integers. The maximum(a, b) method returns the larger value, returning a when a >= b and b otherwise (a simple comparison utility inside class Maximum).

mbpp_0349.reference_description: Write a java function to check whether the given string is a binary string or not.

Description_Simple.reference_text: Write a java function to check whether the given string is a binary string or not.
Description_Simple.comparison_text:
Title: Binary String Validator
